name: Sana-chan to Umi no Ie
original_name: さなちゃんとうみのいえ
source:
Little suntanned Sana slips in and out of her one-piece swimsuit at the beach.
She goes there to play. Her playtime is adult. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE128702.html]DLsite English[/url]]
